opening.evidence: events/game_start.txt:304 fires hidden origin.5 (events/origin_events_1.txt:22-170: spawns a mini fallen empire if needed, schedules origin.10 after 3 days and the gift loop origin.20). Hidden 20 (:401-434) repeats itself every scionRewardTimer days and draws 21 (technology) or 24 (resources) at 50/100. common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:113 on_monthly_pulse fires 50 (-> 51, :1042-1165) and 30 (-> 54, :1375-1399); on_war_beginning :2607 (29); on_fleet_destroyed_victim :1584 (52); hidden 200 (on_yearly_pulse, :567-711) draws 205/210/215/220/225 (10 of 300 each); hidden 11 (on_survey) -> 12 / 13.

uncertain: Timers scionRewardTimer / scionRewardTimerDelay are script variables (@) not read here.

note.en: Hidden 11 picks by owner: the overlord's own Holy World (12) or another fallen empire's (13) (events/origin_events_1.txt:250-340).

notes.zh: 馈赠循环：origin.20每隔“scionRewardTimer”天自我重复；半数给科技（21），半数给合金或消费品（24，以 base 继承21的标题与文本）。
notes.en: The gift loop: hidden 20 repeats every scionRewardTimer days; half the time technology (21), otherwise alloys or consumer goods (24, which inherits 21's title and text via base).
